label: Presentation behavior
_note: T5 editorial synthesis derived from each entry's cited technique text, now with a per-class citation (`class_sources`, 2026-09-19). Classifies how the bait moves in the water; the scorer uses it under post-turnover (fish deep/suspended). Classes: topwater, swim, suspend, fall, bottom. The class→entry mapping remains editorial and is calibrated by the logbook.

provenance.author: kb synthesis (technique-text derive)
provenance.note: class_sources: one T1/T2 quote per class; entry mapping editorial

topwater.quote: Its keel-shaped belly and balanced body create an effortless walk-the-dog action while letting the bait cut just beneath the surface on each turn, closely imitating a fleeing baitfish struggling to escape.

swim.source: Z-Man — ChatterBait Elite EVO HD product page
swim.quote: A hybrid molded split-grip keeper with double-wire retainer locks trailers in place, while the trademarked ChatterBlade® delivers the aggressive hunting action anglers expect.

suspend.source: Take Me Fishing — Bass Fishing Rigs
suspend.quote: Drop shot rigs are also popular bass fishing rigs as they allow you to present a soft plastic lure above the bottom to bass that are suspended just above the bottom.

fall.quote: dosed with a heavy slug of salt to counteract the natural buoyancy of the ElaZtech® material, creating a slow and tantalizing sink rate when fished unweighted

bottom.source: Take Me Fishing — Try a Carolina rig for Minnesota bass
bottom.quote: A Carolina rig works well for bottom-hugging bass for two reasons.
